_comment: Read by backend/tests/test_briefing_checks.py and frontend/tests/briefing-example-checks.test.ts, so the two checkers cannot drift. Each case starts from a base, applies `replace` (exact substrings of the base briefing) and `patch` (deep-merged; a list or null replaces), and names the failed check ids in order and every flagged sentence. Add a case here, never to one side.

briefing.content:
# Monaco Grand Prix 2026 Briefing

## Track Profile
The Circuit de Monaco is 3.337 km of barriers and elevation. It has hosted a Grand Prix since 1929. Overtaking is close to impossible, so qualifying decides most races.

## Championship Context
Kimi Antonelli leads the championship on 131 points after five races. George Russell is second on 88 points, 43 points behind his Mercedes team-mate. Mercedes lead the constructors' standings with 219 points.

## Form Guide
Antonelli won the Canadian Grand Prix last time out, ahead of Lewis Hamilton in P2. Lando Norris won here in 2025.

## Key Storylines
Leclerc's home race always draws a crowd.

## Weather Watch
Weather data was not gathered for a race that has already been run.

## Predictions
- **Pole Position favorites:** Leclerc, Antonelli, Norris
- **Podium prediction:** Antonelli, Leclerc, Hamilton
- **Dark horse:** Colapinto

## Track Profile
The Sepang International Circuit is 5.543 km long and returns to the calendar in 2026.

## Championship Context
Antonelli leads the championship.

## Form Guide
Antonelli won last time out.

## Key Storylines
The Bahrain Grand Prix moves to Malaysia this year.

## Weather Watch
Practice 1 looks wet: 31°C with a 77% chance of rain.

## Predictions
- Antonelli
